انطلقت (form VII)
# اِنْطَلَقْتُ (inṭalaqtu) /in.tˤa.laq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْطَلَقَ (inṭalaqa)
# اِنْطَلَقْتَ (inṭalaqta) /in.tˤa.laq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْطَلَقَ (inṭalaqa)
# اِنْطَلَقْتِ (inṭalaqti) /in.tˤa.laq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْطَلَقَ (inṭalaqa)
# اِنْطَلَقَتْ (inṭalaqat) /in.tˤa.la.qat/: third-pe
